signature.intervention: class-aware linear decay iff IoU>0.7, reselect after decay, floor .001, max_nms 30000, global top500

boundaries: Existing Soft-NMS is an inference intervention, not a new module or publication novelty.
Candidate coverage is independent GT existence, not one-to-one recall/AP.
Scores are deliberately decayed only in the soft arm; normal boxes/scores and weights are unchanged.
Both arms use original-image official ignore rules for scoring and global max_det=500.
Success cannot repair raw-box absence, prove a classifier root cause, or authorize another 200-epoch training.
One fixed configuration, no val threshold search and no test-dev.

official.aggregation_note: Exact calcAccuracy.m class-availability weighting, which repeats a class once per image containing it.

ignore_audit.fp_audit_note: Greedy IoU=0.50 class-wise matching before class-0 raster filtering; ignored score-zero GT matches are neutral.
